title: Americans Put Food First on Vacation
paragraphs: What is the most important part of a vacation? For many Americans, the answer is simple: food. According to a new report, eating at restaurants is the most popular activity for American travelers in summer.

The report was published by the National Restaurant Association, a group that represents restaurants in the United States. In May 2026, it asked more than 1,000 Americans about their summer travel plans. More than half, 55%, said they planned to take at least one trip with an overnight stay in the US in summer.

Among these travelers, 98% said they planned to visit a restaurant on their trip. This was more popular than shopping, at 85%, sightseeing, at 83%, and going to the beach, at 76%. In addition, 88% said they wanted to try a restaurant they had never been to before. To find new places to eat, 87% said they used suggestions from family and friends.
Chad Moutray of the National Restaurant Association said, "Restaurants are central to tourism." In fact, about 30% of a typical restaurant's sales come from tourists.

Some Americans even travel just for food. In another survey by Talker Research for the tourism office Visit Anaheim in October 2025, 21% of Americans said they had taken a trip because of the food. Young people were the most likely to do this. The most popular foods that people wanted to travel for were the Philly cheesesteak in Philadelphia and pizza in New York City. In the same survey, 67% of people said they are more adventurous eaters when they are away from home.
